In regards to your letter of November 1, 1971, the Board of Education met with representatives of the City of Chicago Heights and both agreed that Scheme A submitted July 8, 1971 is most acceptable.
The Board of Education desires the following information:
(1) The price per square foot the State of Illinois will pay School District 170 for the land needed.
(2) The exact number of square footage involved according to Plan A. (My figure comes to 12,485 square feet)
(3) Name the responsible party for the construction of the Cul De Sac on Sunnyside Avenue as shown in Plan A.
(4) Naming the responsible party for the reconstruction of the 8,100 square feet School District 170 will acquire from the City of Chicago Heights. The school board feels that the old street and curbing should be removed and the land be graded and sodded to match the graded level of existing school property.
A prompt reply on the above matters will greatly expedite the entire project. If you have any questions, please do not hesitate to contact me immediately.
Yours truly,
Charles N. Rellis
Assistant Superintendent
